caption: The drawing depicts a child seated on a light-colored toy horse with brown tack, including a bridle and saddle. The child is wearing a large, wide-brimmed black hat, a green scarf tied around the neck, a long-sleeved shirt with a red and white pattern, brown pants, and dark footwear. The child is holding onto the reins and is depicted in a side profile facing to the left. The horse has a light beige coat with darker shading on the legs and face, and its eyes and hooves are distinctly outlined. The background of the image is plain and uncolored, and there is a small text at the bottom right indicating the drawing's reference and the artist's name, "Gwendolyn Jackson."
title: Mechanical Toy
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
